newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.01 rupee down at 42.65 to the dollar on Thursday in the kerb amid a rise in dollar demand. Dealers said they expected the rupee to open steady on Saturday after the Friday weekend.
They said trading was generally dull, but a flurry of dollar buying near the close pushed the rupee down.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 6.50 percent.
